author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Shows viewer cards with privacy controls, several display styles, and a combined Stream Score.
changelog: 4.1.7: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 4.1.7, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.4.2: initial disabled-by-default Spotlight mode with self-only command requests, authenticated creator-only manual display, style-aware fake preview, disclosure gate, cooldowns, bounded ephemeral queue, projection revalidation, and customizable hosted cards.

manifest.name: Viewer Spotlight

actionsProvided.name: THSV Addon - Viewer Spotlight - Settle Reward

installationSteps: Install and enable Viewer Foundation and Community Analytics first.
Install Viewer Spotlight, review public fields, accept the disclosure, and enable it.
Create Twitch and Kick Viewer Spotlight rewards, then choose the YouTube, TikTok and Facebook card command. It registers automatically after restart.
uninstallationSteps: Uninstall the add-on. Its anonymous cooldown records are kept for a later reinstall.

healthChecks.description: Checks that viewers can request their own card and that the overlay shows only safe card details.
